title: One frontend serving several obligation sets on per-set URL prefixes
summary: Each journey frontend can now hold more than one obligation set's configuration in the same Node process, and every set mounts under its own path prefix (/live-animals, /high-risk-plants) instead of at the server root. Every configure* seam takes a set id first and stores per-set state behind an AsyncLocalStorage-backed shared/set-context.js, resolved by a sandboxed onPreAuth extension; routes.js becomes a one-line barrel over a new routes-<set>.js gateway file registered with { routes: { prefix } }; a server-wide GET / 302s to the default set (auth.enabled-gated); journey cookies and the address-handshake token become per-set accessors; a boot-time set-completeness gate refuses to start a set that forgot a required configure call. trade-imports-ins-frontend (which has no set of its own) needed a follow-up fix so its outbound deep links into animals/plants (dashboard notification links, the address-book handshake return URL) target the new set-scoped prefix instead of the frontend root, which now 404s below the bare base URL. trade-imports-animals-tests moved its whole URL-building layer (page objects, adapters, ~20 specs) onto the same per-set prefixes.

plants: 0f2d972 EUDPA-619: let one frontend serve more than one set at the same time (#77)
ins: fd1d21f fix(EUDPA-619): link into the live-animals set, not the frontend root (#32)
tests: 623c3cc EUDPA-619: move the URL layer onto the per-set prefixes (#238)

branchEquivalent.evidence: The alignment branch was cut in all four repos before EUDPA-619 landed on main (report.md ruling 27: 'main has moved under these repos since the alignment was built'; animals and tests each already took a later, unrelated main-merge via ruling 27, but that merge predates 619 and named only status-codes.js/errors.test.js as chassis touches - 619 landed after). Confirmed directly: (1) animals' and plants' branch-side routes.js is still the full pre-split single-set inline gateway with no set-context wiring and no prefix, verbatim; (2) ins's branch-side view-model/list.js and dashboard/controller.test.js still build and assert bare, unprefixed links into the animals frontend (`config.get('tradeImportsAnimalsFrontend.baseUrl')` with no /live-animals, and `href="http://localhost:3000/notifications/..."` with no prefix); (3) the tests repo's branch-side base-page.ts/notification-dashboard-page.ts have none of main's set-base URL anchoring or journeyIdFromUrl fix. Nothing in this cluster's behaviour exists on the branch yet, anywhere.

verdictWhy: Every conflict and every silent gap below has been walked to a concrete, evidence-based resolution - reading all three git blobs plus the merged tree for each conflicting file, and cross-checking against byte-equal converged sibling files (e.g. router.test.js's 'dashboard not registered when auth disabled' assertion settles the auth.enabled-gate placement in router.js without guesswork). The work is large in volume (21 real conflicts across 4 repos, plus 4 files where git silently dropped one side's change with no conflict marker at all) and repetitive in shape (the same routes.js/router.js/context.js/errors.js/auth-controller.js pattern recurs in animals and plants; the same #/-alias and stale-URL-assertion pattern recurs three times in ins), but no open judgement call remains that isn't already settled by an existing test or an explicit precedence rule (main decides behaviour, the alignment ledger decides structure/naming). One genuine open question is flagged for Sam regardless (ins's #/ import alias), with a default that follows the alignment's already-standing (not reversed) decision.

preAlign.what: Land either comment wording for the DATE_TEXT_SHAPE four-digit-year guard in src/server/app/lib/validate/calendar.js as its own trivial commit on the branch now (the regex and logic are already byte-identical to main; only one comment sentence differs).
preAlign.why: This is convergent evolution, not a real disagreement - main's 619 and the branch's own ruling-5 validate-convergence independently wrote the identical fix. Landing it now removes one of the ten animals conflicts from the list entirely before the merge, for near-zero cost.

wireIn.what: Rewrite the #/-aliased imports in main's two brand-new files (src/server/common/helpers/set-base-url.js and its test) to relative paths (../../../config/config.js), since the branch's package.json no longer declares the #/ imports alias.

Update two test files that git treated as unrelated additions (no rename correlation, no conflict marker) so their hardcoded URL assertions carry the /live-animals prefix, matching what the now-fixed journey-registry.js and view-model/list.js actually produce.

Rename the export main's new routes-live-animals.js file uses (liveAnimals) to the alignment's established serviceRoutes convention, so router.js's existing `import { serviceRoutes } from './app/routes.js'` keeps resolving without router.js itself needing an import-name change.
wireIn.where: src/server/app/routes-live-animals.js (new file from main), src/server/app/routes.js (the barrel)

wireIn.where: src/server/app/routes-high-risk-plants.js (new file from main), src/server/app/routes.js (the barrel)

behaviourChanges: The server-wide GET / -> default-set redirect that main's 619 registers unconditionally becomes gated behind auth.enabled in the merged result (animals and plants), because the alignment's router.test.js already pins 'the dashboard is not registered when auth is disabled' (GET / -> 404). With auth disabled, / now 404s instead of redirecting - a real behavioural difference from main alone, though not from the branch's existing auth-gating convention.

CORRECTION: this entry originally said 'ins' but describes animals/plants, which are the only two repos where 619 touches auth/controller.js - ins's own auth/controller.js was not touched by main's fd1d21f commit and is out of this cluster's scope. In animals and plants, the sign-in error / unauthorised page's copy comes from sharedCopy.errorPage / sharedCopy.unauthorised (the alignment's machine-drafted-Welsh-ready copy bundle) rather than main's own hardcoded/inline English string, while still using main's setlessBase()/serverWideBase() mechanism (animals/plants respectively) so the page renders correctly outside any set's mount.

A plain git merge (taking the clean auto-resolution of the import line at face value, without hand-fixing the unmarked hunks) leaves TWO call sites in BOTH animals' and plants' src/server/auth/controller.js - the organisationId-missing guard and the getPermissions-failure catch, both added by the alignment's own 'Backported to animals and plants' auth-convergence ruling, outside the git-flagged conflict region - calling an unimported base() function once the conflicted import line resolves to main's renamed setlessBase()/serverWideBase(). Neither pure main nor pure branch has this defect; it only exists in a naive merge. A sign-in with no organisationId, or a failing getPermissions call, throws ReferenceError: base is not defined at runtime. Confirmed independently in both repos' trial-merge trees, not inferred from one to the other. Must be hand-fixed per each repo's auth/controller.js resolution (all four call sites use the same helper).

ins's outbound links into the animals and plants frontends (dashboard notification links, 'Start a new notification', the address-book handshake return URL) now correctly carry /live-animals - none of that worked on the branch before this merge; it was pointing at the frontend root, which 404s below the bare base URL once a set is mounted.
knockOn: src/server/router.js and src/server/app/routes.js in animals and plants carry a second, non-619 change from ruling 2 (auth convergence: the serviceRoutes export name, the signout/ deletion, the auth.enabled gate over every non-health route) - the 619 part of the conflict is resolved above; the auth-convergence/cross-service-shape cluster owns the gate/export-naming/signout-deletion decisions themselves.

plants' src/server/common/helpers/errors.test.js and src/server/app/services/countries/ carry EUDPA-575 (reference-data 503 handling) and question-29 (countries reader shape) content that is adjacent to but not part of 619 - not surveyed here.

tests/e2e/features/auth.spec.ts's conflict is shared with the auth-convergence cluster (ruling 2's sign-out URL unification, pages.signOut.path, BasePage.linkSignOut) - the 619 part (the previously-always-true assertion that 619 broke and main's follow-up fix corrected) is fully absorbed by the branch's existing convergence; nothing further to port from 619's side.

animals' src/server/app/lib/validate/{calendar,validate}.test.js and validators.js were also touched by both main and the branch but merge clean; these belong to ruling 5's broader validate-text convergence, not 619 - not surveyed further here.

openQuestions.question: ins's set-base-url.js and set-base-url.test.js (both new files from main) import config via the #/ alias, which the alignment's package.json no longer declares (report.md lists 'restore the #/ alias' as a reversible decision, never actually reversed). Should these two files' imports be rewritten to relative paths (matching every other file in src/server/common/helpers/), or is this the moment to reinstate the alias project-wide?
openQuestions.default: Rewrite to relative paths, matching the branch's current, standing convention. Reinstating the alias is a separate, already-flagged reversible decision (report.md's 'Decisions you may want to reverse') and should not be smuggled in as a side effect of porting an unrelated ticket's two new files.

claims.statement: Main's 619 commit turns routes.js into a one-line barrel and moves the whole single-set gateway into routes-<set-id>.js, registered under a path prefix.
claims.quote: routes.js becomes a one-line barrel over routes-live-animals.js, and the gateway registers under { routes: { prefix: '/live-animals' } }. / is a server-wide 302 to the default set

claims.statement: The alignment branch's own routes.js, at the point of the trial merge, is still the full pre-split inline gateway with no set-context wiring - confirmed by reading the branch blob directly.

The branch's own router.test.js already pins that the whole set registration (and, by extension, whatever else lives in that block) is gated behind auth.enabled, settling how main's 619 registration+redirect must be nested in the merged router.js.
ins's alignment branch has no #/ import alias declared in package.json, so main's #/-aliased imports in its 619 fix will not resolve once merged.
claims.quote: (grep -A5 '"imports"' on the branch's package.json returns no match - the field is absent)

claims.statement: ins's branch-side add.controller.test.js still asserts the pre-619 unprefixed RETURN_URL, with no conflict marker raised anywhere - git treated the whole file as an unrelated deletion.
ins's branch-side dashboard/controller.test.js (the spiritual descendant of main's routes/home/controller.test.js) still asserts unprefixed hrefs into the animals frontend.
Main's own 619 fix in ins explicitly explains why the sign-in error page must not resolve a set from ambient/sole-set fallback state.

claims.quote: /auth/* is server-wide, outside every set's mount, so nothing set-owned can be resolved here. kit.base() would reach for the set's layout, section caption and mount prefix, and answer only by falling back to the sole mounted set - right today and wrong the moment a second set mounts.
